description: This is a Zephyr-based Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) application source file implementing a custom GATT service with read and write characteristics, handling Bluetooth initialization, bonding, advertising, and pairing.

methods.name: read_signed
methods.description: Handles reading the signed_value attribute over GATT.

methods.name: write_signed
methods.description: Handles writing to the signed_value attribute over GATT.

methods.name: copy_last_bonded_addr
methods.description: Copies the last bonded device address.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth, loads settings, and starts advertising.

methods.name: pairing_complete
methods.description: Handles pairing completion and reboots device.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth and entering main loop.
